claims.statement: `git write-tree` creates a tree object from the current index and prints its name, so a filled temporary index gives the tree of the worktree → verdict matching, handoff
`GIT_INDEX_FILE` sets the location of the index file, so a temporary index leaves the real one alone, and the variable must reach both `git add` and `git write-tree` → verdict matching, Gotchas
A message opens with a short subject line, then a blank line, then a body that explains why the change is made rather than listing what the code does → delivery files, commit-message template

sources.title: Xonovex change-workflow conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original rules for the delivery text of one work item, built on the contract of **recording-handoff**: the three delivery files and their schemas, the delivery modes, verdict matching by tree hash, self-check labels, inline comment markers, the content scan, and the handoff of the commit to **using-git** and of the push, pull request and comments to **using-github** or **using-gitlab**

claims.statement: The step runs the entry step of **recording-handoff** first; the delivery files carry the shared header with a skill actor and no `verified` entry and are replaced in place on a rerun; criteria are marked only from a verdict whose tree hash equals the worktree's; the report gives the commit command only under that same equality; the words follow **authoring-pull-requests** and the conventional commit rules of **using-git**; the step commits, pushes and opens nothing.
